requirements.text: What you'll do...Role Summary: As a Software Engineer III at Walmart, you will build and operate highly available, scalable distributed and SQL platform capabilities for enterprise-grade, mission-critical services. This role supports NoSQL products such as Cosmos and Spanner, and SQL products such as Postgres across public and private clouds. The engineer will contribute to API development, backend engineering, site reliability, DevOps automation, and operational excellence. The ideal candidate has strong Java and Python experience, distributed and SQL systems knowledge, production operations expertise, and a focus on automation, observability, reliability, incident response, and Walmart’s values. About the Team: The Data Services team drives the development and operation of scalable, highly available distributed SQL and NoSQL platforms supporting enterprise applications. Focusing on backend engineering, API development, site reliability, and DevOps automation, the team ensures platform stability and continuous improvement. By applying automation and AI-assisted engineering practices, the group emphasizes operational excellence and innovation. Collaborating across product, infrastructure, and operations teams, the team fosters a culture of technical excellence, ownership, and alignment with Walmart’s core values of integrity, respect, service, and excellence. What You'll Do:

Database Technologies, experience to maintain, manage and support applications and empathy towards problem solving
Proven experience in software engineering with strong technical acumen and proficiency in object-oriented programming and API design.
Demonstrated ability to deliver scalable, maintainable, and high-availability software solutions using iterative and incremental development methodologies.
Expertise in debugging, root cause analysis, and troubleshooting complex production issues to ensure system reliability.
Skilled in continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) practices, including automation scripting and telemetry implementation.
Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to translate business requirements into effective technical solutions.
Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams and mentoring junior engineers.

Option 1: Bachelor's degree in computer science, computer engineering, computer information systems, software engineering, or related area and 2 years’ experience in software engineering or related area.

Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Computer Information Systems, Software Engineering, or related area, We value candidates with a background in creating inclusive digital experiences, demonstrating knowledge in implementing Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.2 AA standards, assistive technologies, and integrating digital accessibility seamlessly. The ideal candidate would have knowledge of accessibility best practices and join us as we continue to create accessible products and services following Walmart’s accessibility standards and guidelines for supporting an inclusive culture.
